description: ComEd's anonymized AMI energy usage data is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. One of the key impacts of AMI technology is the availability of interval energy usage data, which can support the development of new products and services and to enable the market to deliver greater value to customers. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are AMI meters, interval energy usage data, Advanced Metering Infrastructure meters. The portal shows 2024-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
